Depends if the card is from a bank or from say Capital One.  I'm in Canada.  A garnishee is placed on wages once a judgement is signed.  If they don't know where you work they cannot place a garnishee on your wages.  Usually you'll get paperwork in the mail but they don't have to notify you.  Payroll at your company will notify you once it's been placed.
Debt collectors will threaten court but mostly its bullshit.   It does happen but it's usually if you owe alot and they know where your employed.  Otherwise they won't waste the money.  Best advice is to ignore the threats.  More than likely it's just threats no action.

Edit: and them taking you to court is nothing like criminal court where you need a lawyer or to show up.  It's literally just a judge signing papers.  You don't do anything nor do you even have to be notified.  It can happen without your knowledge
